mapper.insert: INSERT INTO td_data_resource ( resource_id, resource_name, resource_type, org_id, org_name, datasource_id, source_path, description, tags, status, field_count, record_count, last_sync_time, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{resourceId}, #{resourceName}, #{resourceType}, #{orgId}, #{orgName}, #{datasourceId}, #{sourcePath}, #{description}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{fieldCount}, #{recordCount}, #{lastSyncTime}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE td_data_resource SET resource_name = #{resourceName}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, description = #{description}, tags = #{tags}, status = #{status}, field_count = #{fieldCount}, record_count = #{recordCount}, last_sync_time = #{lastSyncTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.resource_id, r.resource_name, r.resource_type, r.org_id, r.org_name, r.datasource_id, r.source_path, r.description, r.tags, r.status, r.field_count, COALESCE(r.record_count, CASE WHEN c.reltuples > 0 THEN c.reltuples::bigint ELSE NULL END) AS record_count, r.last_sync_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time FROM td_data_resource r LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = SPLIT_PART(r.source_path, '.', 2) WHERE r.datasource_id = #{datasourceId} ORDER BY r.resource_name
SELECT * FROM td_data_resource ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM td_data_resource WHERE resource_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR description ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR source_path ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY resource_name
